sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.person_id FROM person p WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - p.year_of_birth) > 80 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = p.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (201826))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurement m WHERE m.person_id = p.person_id AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (3016723)) AND m.value_as_number < 50);
